algorithm: Python random.Random with sorted canonical inputs before shuffling
source_blind_id: first 16 hex characters of SHA-256('20261027:source:' + source_id)
item_id: first 16 hex characters of SHA-256 over the canonical evidence and two view texts, prefixed I-
view_order: deterministic bit from SHA-256('20261027:view:' + item_id); audience labels are kept only in sealed_mapping.json
constraints: Inputs are sorted before pseudorandom operations.
Identical natural outputs for one source and evidence record are deduplicated and mapped to all logical roles privately.
Mechanical null outputs and explicitly non-instantiated diagnostic slots are sealed as nonreviewable and are not placed in either rater packet.
Condition, generation stage, repair status, checker results, intended variant label, mutation type, and benchmark gold label are absent from rater packets.
Operational blinding also requires withholding the original private exports and sealed mapping from raters. Hash-derived identifiers are not cryptographic anonymization.
